title: Memory-card holder
about: eight SD and twelve microSD cards in upright slots: one column per row of a card table, names engraved in front
tries: Add miniSD cards (21.5 × 20 × 1.4 mm) to cards.csv | Lean every slot back 10° so the cards are easier to read

agent.role: a desk-storage designer who lays out slots from a table of card formats
agent.prompt: Prefer adding rows to cards.csv over new params or cuts; size every slot from the card plus `gap` on each side; never make a slot narrower than three line widths.

fragments.table: Keep card sizes in cards.csv in millimetres, one row per format, and cite the SD Association or ISO size in a comment.
fragments.labels: Engrave labels 0.6 mm deep on the top face with j.region.text, at most as wide as the column.
